title: Smith provider — format-skill.yaml
description: Per-kind YAML describing the skill / slash-command artefact for a provider. Documents the artefact's frontmatter spec and body authoring conventions.

title.description: Human-readable title (used in the dashboard / listings).

consumer_path.description: Where the artefact lives in a consumer project.

example.description: Relative path to the companion example file under example/. Filename MUST start with example-skill and may carry a provider-specific suffix before the extension (e.g. example-skill.prompt.md).

default.description: Default value (any type) — use null for none.

allowed.description: Allowed values — string description or array of literals.
